The system image carries module %1$s, newer than the kept app %2$s. Android refuses an app-only downgrade below the system image, and this phone has no archive of the previous module to put back. Install the previous release\'s module from the update document, then check again.

Reinstall the previous app?

Reinstalls module %1$s as root, removes the app update installed on this phone so the module\'s copy is used again, and reboots once the removal is verified.
To come back, install %1$s again from Updates.
Removing the app update can erase this app\'s data, which means pairing this phone again. Newer data is usually kept because the versions match, but a reset is possible.

An older version is never installed over a newer one. Use the rollback to go back.

Another policy or the system installer refused this update. Allow installs from Phonxiety, then try again.

The install was canceled before it finished. Try again.

No previous app is kept
No previous APK is kept, so there is nothing to roll back to.
No previous module is kept
The system image is newer than the kept app and no archive of the previous module is kept, so nothing can be put back. Nothing on the phone changed.
The system image\'s version is unknown
The APK mounted on the system image could not be read, so the downgrade floor is unknown. Nothing on the phone changed.
The rollback archive cannot be read
The rollback archive could not be read. Nothing on the phone changed.
The kept module is not older
The kept module archive is not older than the system image\'s copy, so it is not a rollback. Nothing on the phone changed.
The kept module changed since the check
The published archive is not the one this check planned for. Nothing on the phone changed; check again before rolling back.
Nothing to roll back to
This phone already runs the kept version, so there is nothing to roll back to.
The rollback files could not be written

The previous module was not staged
The module installer refused the previous zip, so nothing on the phone changed.
The removal script did not start

The previous module is staged, but the removal script could not start: the app update is still installed, and a reboot now can leave the older module next to the newer app. Retry the rollback before rebooting.

Root is not available
Grant root to Phonxiety in the manager, then try again.
